dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Huh, so that's what you wanted to ask me about. Let me have a look, and I'll mark some of them out on the map for you...

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Still, I can't help you mark everything out. Guild rules, you know...?

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Also, I'm pretty sure Mondstadt is supposed to be under Cyrus's jurisdiction. Seriously, that guy...

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Well, I've marked them out. Have a look.
